summary: Lewis Hamilton faces a reckoning at Circuit of the Americas as Kimi Antonelli closes in on the championship, with the Ferrari driver needing just points to clinch the crown in Austin. Behind the title fight, McLaren hunts Red Bull for the constructors' championship, setting up a fierce three-way battle for supremacy across both competitions. An Antonelli coronation would mark Ferrari's first drivers' championship since 2007 and potentially reshape the constructor's standings with three races remaining.
